🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 24, 2026

Moon, in Gemini, holds a square to Mars, in Leo. Two ways of valuing a thing, meeting at one point: what you hold is weighed against what it cost to hold it.

Easier — Seeing the real cost of an arrangement you had stopped examining.
Harder — Defending a position you no longer hold for reasons you no longer have.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Gemini, Moon offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Fire moves first here, and first is enough. A week ago Mars was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you and holds Libra by right, not by favour. Mars squares you from Leo, and something has to give way. Earth keeps its grip past the point it is worth. Four weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, where nothing is owed to it. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Mutable air: the two accounts collapse into one. The square to Pluto that held a week ago has let go.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, untitled in Gemini. From Libra, Venus sets a figure against the wanting. Water opens the file, and the file has a price. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you and passes through Sagittarius as a guest. Moon in Gemini leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Fire keeps what it has, cheaply. Sun has not been in Scorpio for four weeks.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon squares you from Gemini, and the cost objects. Earth bends, and each bend is invoiced. Forward again for two weeks now, Mercury has left the old ground.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you from its own Libra. Moon in Gemini sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal air: the opening move is the cheap one. The hold Moon had a week ago is not there any more.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Mercury crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Fixed water: what you hold and who you are merge. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. From Gemini, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Mutable fire: keeping options is the expense. The same angle for four weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Venus squares you from Libra: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Cardinal earth meets a bill. After four weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, has no support in Aries and asks twice for half. From Gemini, Moon concedes the point early. Air that holds on, holding without strain. The trine of four weeks ago is off it now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you from Leo, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. From Gemini, Moon cuts across the appetite. Mutable water keeps two accounts open and pays both. Moon let go of it a week ago.
